claim.why_it_matters: The two numeric-edited sub-lines are merged onto one line and the blank category cell is dropped, so the line-by-line pairing now reads Numeric-edited -> Alphanumeric and 'if usage is display / if usage is national' -> National, losing that a numeric-edited receiver of usage display gets an alphanumeric figurative constant and one of usage national gets a national one.

verdict.reasoning:
Rendered page 559 (printed 535), Table 18: the HIGH-VALUE/LOW-VALUE/QUOTE row shows nine receiving-operand lines, with 'Numeric-edited' followed by indented sub-lines '— if usage is display' and '— if usage is national'; the category column has a blank line opposite 'Numeric-edited', then 'Alphanumeric' and 'National' opposite the two sub-lines. page-559.md line 9 joins the two sub-lines into one
segment (8 segments) and drops the blank category cell (8 segments), so the positional pairing becomes Numeric-edited -> Alphanumeric and the merged usage line -> National. The national-usage numeric-edited case loses its own pairing, which changes the meaning of the table. Claim quotes both sources accurately.
